before: Shape outlines changed color, width, and visibility only. Shape and chart controls existed only inside the Format shape pane and the chart pane.
after: setShapeOutline and the setShapeFormat op take an optional dash. It writes a:prstDash, and v:stroke/@dashstyle on a VML shape or fallback, and shapeFormat reads it back. The shape and chart controls are placeable parts and toolbar slots that run the existing shape and chart commands.
reason: A dash is ordinary OOXML markup in the shared tree. An older participant keeps and saves those elements and already paints them. Only its pane does not show the dash name. The parts and slots are local chrome over existing commands. No shared field, snapshot, awareness payload, or protocol message changes.
